K1.stone_why: Faceted, flat-cut curves on the bold S, 3, 5, 6, 8 and O read clearly as hewn letters on an inscriptional serif skeleton, though the regular titles stay close to a conventional book serif.
K1.carving_why: Facets are applied consistently across bold capitals and digits with crisp straight cuts, 0/O and 3/8 stay distinct, but a few joins (the tip of the 6, the lower bowl of the 5) are slightly lopsided and the regular weight carries the carving only faintly.
K1.calm_why: A measured serif with moderate weight contrast between regular and bold; the cuts add presence without shouting.
K1.personality_why: The polygonal bowls give it a recognisable chiselled voice, though the regular titles fall back toward a generic serif.

K2.stone_why: A clean, smooth-curved transitional serif with only a faint classical inscription feel and no hewn quality.
K2.carving_why: No visible carving; all curves in S, 3, 5, 6, 8 and O are smooth.
K2.calm_why: Very calm and steady with good presence in the bold, never loud.
K2.personality_why: Well made but anonymous; it reads as a stock book serif you would not recognise again.

K3.stone_why: Nearly identical to K1: faceted bold capitals and digits read as cut stone over an inscriptional serif base, regular titles less so.
K3.carving_why: Coherent, crisp facets across S, 3, 5, 6, 8 and O with digits easy to tell apart; the 6 and 5 bowls are a touch more evenly polygonal than K1's, but the regular weight still barely shows the cuts.
K3.calm_why: Steady and composed, with the bold giving presence without aggression.
K3.personality_why: Distinct chiselled voice in the bold and numerals, softened by a conventional-looking regular.

K4.stone_why: Heavier, faceted letters throughout, including the regular titles, read most strongly as blocky carved inscription.
K4.carving_why: Carving is present across every weight and is mostly coherent, but at this weight some facets look chunky and slightly lopsided (the S of Squat, the 5 and the 2), though digits remain clearly distinguishable.
K4.calm_why: Strong presence, but the uniformly heavy weight, including the bold-looking 13 px body text, tips toward loud and dense rather than calm.
K4.personality_why: The most unmistakable of the four: a heavy, hewn slab-serif voice you would recognise immediately.
